set.body:
Purpose and scope
Implement PostgreSQL parity using a new checked migration after V006. Bind publication request identity to its draft/receipt independently of the existing destination/invocation submission binding. Keep legacy submission paths and stored payloads decodable. Check current authority and expected head in the transaction; concurrent retries must resolve to one binding.

Acceptance proof
Run shared publication cases on PostgreSQL. Add concurrent same-key requests, changed-key payload rejection, stale destination head, migration/checksum and historical-record cases. Verify rollback leaves no visible partial release or incomplete required projection.

Start here
modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/{PostgresCatalog,JsonCodecs,PostgresDatabase}.scala; modules/postgres/src/main/resources/sanctity/postgres; modules/integration/src/test/scala/sanctity/postgres

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: P3: Persist publication intents with transactional authority and retry binding
